name: 00_current
description: Current viewer defaults, used as the baseline for the 15 FPS problem.

name: 01_no_readback
description: Disable CPU particle readback to estimate GPU/CPU synchronization cost.

name: 02_no_self_collision
description: Disable density/grid self collision to estimate broadphase and collision cost.

name: 03_low_solver
description: Reduce solver iterations to 3 to estimate iteration cost.

name: 04_no_debug_draw
description: Disable debug draw overlays and guide/follower debug lines.

name: 05_render_light
description: Use billboard rendering and hide scalp to estimate draw/overdraw contribution.
